name: Azad Engineering Ltd.
about: Azad Engineering Limited manufactures and sells precision-engineered components for energy and power generation, aerospace and defence, and oil and gas industries in India and internationally. It offers fixed air foil, last stage air foil rotary, welding chamfers, last stage air foil stationary, stator and rotor air foils, compressor air foils, hot gas parts, slips, drill bits, hatch cover, bonnet, and frame. The company also provides unison rings, arm, levers, assembly, body, housing, compressor and mount, valve body, butterfly plate, seal, shaft and bearing rod, piston plate and sealing ring, actuator, cover and housing, guide, poppet, tees and elbows, nipples and adaptors, aft and fore end skirt, bb2kp base, and b1 ignitor body 1 and 2. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~44% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 12.4% cost of equity).
PE of 110 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 145), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 110 vs sector median 45; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 47, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 162% a year while PE moved 527 → 110.
